name: gptoss120b
note: RULES.md section 4, version 7 (2026-11-20). OpenAI family: gpt-oss-120b in its released MXFP4 (OpenRouter calls it fp4); reasons before answering, effort medium (the default of Keller et al. 2026 and the TREC 2025 RAG ensemble), with room for the reasoning. Providers: the cheapest that serves fp4 and accepts the seed and the reasoning setting, as listed on 2026-11-20, then the next one; no other.

name: deepseekv32
